create.name: Julie E. Brent
create.bio:
Julie E. Brent has worked with subtle energy since the mid-1980s, starting with Polarity and going on to study a long list of hands-on methods before settling on Reiki, which she has taught since the mid-1990s, and Quantum-Touch, in which she is a certified practitioner and was once a Level One instructor. She also draws on Light Language and sound work, and describes herself as a conscious channel; she first recognised this ability around 1999 while working in Phoenix for Drunvalo Melchizedek, and she sometimes teaches under the name Serena Blue.

Today she runs a small studio, your.WELL.being, in Fairhope, Alabama, and has also taught in Lexington, Kentucky. She offers private Quantum-Touch and Reiki sessions in person and by phone or Zoom, Usui and Karuna Reiki certification classes, and a method of her own called Tri-Spiral Healing, which uses intention and spiralling movements of energy and is offered both as short distance sessions and as an afternoon workshop. Her 'Learning to Drive Your 5th Dimensional Vehicle' series explores dimensions and conscious creation in small online groups, and her site shares channelled practices such as the Healing the Earth Meditation, which works with a twelve-chakra system, and the Earth-Self grounding meditation she received in Hawaii in 2007.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch private sessions
courses.description: One-hour Quantum-Touch sessions to build and run life-force energy, given hands-on or at a distance by phone or Zoom. Clients get in touch with their location and time zone to arrange a time.

courses.title: 8:8 Tri-Spiral Healing sessions
courses.description: A run of eight-minute distance sessions over eight days using Julie's own Tri-Spiral method, which works with intention and spiralling energy. Sessions are held virtually, remotely or by phone.

courses.title: Tri-Spiral Healing workshop (Fairhope studio)
courses.description: An afternoon workshop at her your.WELL.being studio in Fairhope where students learn to use intention and spiralling energy for themselves and others. Booked on request for a Sunday of your choice.

courses.title: Usui and Karuna Reiki classes
courses.description: Reiki certification weekends covering Usui Levels I and II, with attunements, plus Karuna Reiki levels for practitioners going further. Classes run in Fairhope or Lexington, and she will teach in other cities on request.

courses.title: Learning to Drive Your 5th Dimensional Vehicle (workshop series)
courses.description: A series of two-to-three-hour classes, held fortnightly or monthly, on dimensions, conscious creation and the vocabulary for talking about inner experience. It runs by conference call once enough students sign up.

free_resources.title: Healing the Earth Meditation
free_resources.description: A channelled group meditation, written out in full on her site, that spirals energy through a twelve-chakra system and sends it to the heart of the Earth. She invites readers to copy and share it freely.
